**Check first:** search the issues and [`docs/planning/FUTURE_IDEAS.md`](../../docs/planning/FUTURE_IDEAS.md) — the idea may already be tracked.

## Problem

What problem are you trying to solve? Describe the user need, not just "add X".

## Proposed solution

How do you imagine this working? Keep it concrete enough to discuss.

## Alternatives

What else did you consider?

## Notes

- Does this depend on any third-party service, dataset, or license? (Data/attribution
  matters — see [`docs/data/SOURCES.md`](../../docs/data/SOURCES.md).)
- Platform scope: desktop suite, mobile, or both?
